audit_flags.description: Historical Racial Reclassification: Recorded under multiple distinct racial categories across federal records (1930: Indian (Struck-through) ➔ 1930: Negro (Supervisor Alteration)). Exemplifies the tripartite legal classification pressures and racial boundary fluidity characteristic of Delmarva Afro-Indigenous families.
